import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_1.csv')
g = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost']
stats = g.agg(['mean','median','std','max','count'])
# z-score based detection within each group
def detect(grp):
    m = grp['BilledCost'].mean()
    s = grp['BilledCost'].std()
    if s>0:
        z = (grp['BilledCost']-m)/s
        return z.abs().idxmax()
    return None
# Simpler: compute median absolute deviation per group and flag
results=[]
for (acc,svc), grp in g:
    med = grp['BilledCost'].median()
    mad = (grp['BilledCost']-med).abs().median()
    if mad>0:
        score = (grp['BilledCost']-med)/mad
    else:
        score = grp['BilledCost'].max()-grp['BilledCost'].min()
    i = score.abs().idxmax()
    results.append((score.loc[i], acc, svc, grp.loc[i,'ChargePeriodStart'], grp.loc[i,'BilledCost']))
results.sort(reverse=True)
for r in results[:10]:
    print(r)
